summary.text: Kim Ahern is the Democratic nominee. She was a prosecutor for nearly a decade under three attorneys general, working in the Special Victims Unit, served on Gov. Gina Raimondo's team, and is chair of the Rhode Island Cannabis Control Commission. She has made prosecuting violent crime, defending state law against federal actions and consumer protection her main themes.

paragraphs.text: Prosecutor for nearly a decade under three attorneys general, including in the Special Victims Unit, prosecuting more than 1,000 cases according to her campaign.
Served on Gov. Gina Raimondo's team (per her campaign site); chair of the Rhode Island Cannabis Control Commission (per Providence Eye).
